memory_candidates.content: When rewriting one field of a JSON-lines (JSONL) record in place with jq (`jq --arg v "$x" '.field = $v'`), always pass `-c` (compact mode). Without it, jq pretty-prints the output across multiple lines, which silently breaks a one-JSON-object-per-line file's line-count invariant and corrupts any later line-based read of the file. Caught by a fixture idempotence test, not by inspection.

When a script rewrites a shared ledger/queue file another process also reads-and-rewrites, take the SAME named flock the other process uses around the WHOLE read-mutate-write cycle (acquired before the read, released after the write), not just around the final write. Locking only the write leaves a read-then-lose-the-race window open against a concurrent writer.

verify-deploy.sh's --gate8-touched narrowing falls back to the full, unnarrowed run-all.sh battery (the 'full-sweep sentinel') whenever ANY one of the given touched paths has no suite_selection_select-resolvable covering suite -- e.g. a brand-new script with no test suite yet, or any markdown file (which structurally has none). Scope --gate8-touched to only the paths that DO have covering suites to get an actually-narrowed roster; handle the remaining paths via their own named checks run directly.

sapience_notes.subject: jq compact-mode rewrite of JSONL records
sapience_notes.value: jq --arg v "$x" '.field = $v' without -c pretty-prints the output across multiple lines by default, which corrupts a one-JSON-object-per-line file (e.g. a JSONL ledger) on any subsequent line-based read. Always pass -c when rewriting a single field of a JSONL record in place.

sapience_notes.subject: extract_local.py's _ledger_lock default lock path
sapience_notes.value: extract_local.py's _ledger_lock class (default name='ledger') takes a blocking exclusive flock on ~/.sapience/.ledger.lock around every load-update-rewrite of pending_kos.jsonl/extracted.json. An extension-owned script touching the same ledger must take the identical lock to avoid the exact lost-write race this class was built to prevent (Ari Sklar #8, 2026-09-19).

sapience_notes.subject: Sapience vault KO surface has no update or delete
sapience_notes.value: The vault's knowledge-object surface offers create (POST /ingest-kos) and read (/v1/search, /v1/ko/subjects) only; DELETE /v1/ko/<hash>, DELETE /v1/kos/<hash>, and POST /v1/ko/<hash>/delete all return 404. Every posted KO's provenance -- tagged or not -- is permanent; manual removal in the web app is the only remedy, and it deletes rather than retags.

sapience_notes.subject: Sapience transcript-capture live pipeline on this machine
sapience_notes.value: The live local transcript-extraction pipeline is ~/.sapience/extract_local.py, selected by ~/.sapience/config.json's "backend": "anthropic" key -- not upload.py, which extract_local.py merely imports for a handful of shared helpers while defining its own independent, dead-for-this-machine _chunk()/post_kos()/main() path.

sapience_notes.subject: verify-deploy.sh gate8 touched-path narrowing fallback
sapience_notes.value: verify-deploy.sh's --gate8-touched narrowing falls back to the full unnarrowed run-all.sh battery whenever any given touched path has no suite_selection_select-resolvable covering suite -- including a brand-new not-yet-tested script or any markdown file. Scoping --gate8-touched to only the paths that do have covering suites avoids the fallback.

sapience_notes.subject: Gate 8 contention under multi-task /orchestrate batch
sapience_notes.value: Under a heavy concurrent multi-task /orchestrate batch, verify-deploy.sh --only-gate 8 can report [FAIL] with a [CONTENTION] 1-minute-load-average line even when every underlying suite in the narrowed roster actually passes -- confirmed by re-running the identical --only roster directly via run-all.sh with no wrapper and no artificial per-gate deadline (34 passed, 0 failed). Treat such a FAIL as a contention/timeout artifact pending direct re-confirmation, not an automatic regression signal.
